<div class="card-body">
'''TIE Assault Squadron''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] ([[Squadron]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タイ攻撃編隊</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊1つのロケーションにいる3機のTIE／LNと交換する（TIE／LNはユーズド・デッキに行く）。合計で能力値3の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-TIE-Assault-Squadron-PSA-157709601.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍は物量作戦を好む。パイロットたちの士気は決して高くないが、“狼の群れ”式の集団戦術がそれを補っている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' TIE assault formation.

'''Card text:'''
* Replaces 3 TIE/LN at one location (the TIE/LN go to the Used Pile). Permanent pilots aboard provide total ability 3.

'''Lore:'''
The Empire prefers quantity tactics. The pilots' morale is never high, but “wolfpack” group tactics make up for it.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 編隊：TIE／LN.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[TIE Assault Squadron]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
